what: Q04 fake-tree golden (results/prereg06/design/spec.md 9.3 item 1; PREREG_06 5.1): the deterministic outputs of test02's competition-1 dry run (t02_fake_tests.py from-val -> t02_checks.py t1 --only T1.1,T1.2,T1.3 -> t02_player.py run seam_val / public / private --dry-run -> submit --dry-run), recorded on branch p06-testday before tools/t06_player.py existed. tests/test_t06_dryrun.py Q04Golden and the pre-merge check must reproduce every value under files_sha256 and reports_normalised_sha256.
tree: S = the from-val tree (tests/test_t02_dryrun.py FromValPipeline workdir('fromval') when recorded; tests/test_t06_dryrun.py uses its own workdir); paths below are relative to S
normalise_rule: json.load; drop the keys ['provenance', 'runtime_s'] at any depth; replace the values at the key paths ['notebook/config_sha256', 'notebook_config_sha256', 't1/sha256', 'test_bundle/MANIFEST.json', 'seam/sha256', 'seam_local/sha256', 'pools/*/apply_report_sha256', 'pools/*/pool_select_sha256'] with '<volatile>' (SHA-256 of files with a creation time); a string that is a path with a data/local segment (either slash, absolute or relative) becomes 'data/local/<rest>' with forward slashes; replace the tree's absolute path (backslash and slash forms) inside every other string with '<S>'; sha256 of json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) as UTF-8
